body:
Hello! There is a CI error with quite a few formatting suggestions. They can be fixed manually, but it's also recommended to use pre-commit to let it fix formatting for you whenever you create a new commit!
```
pip install pre-commit
pre-commit install
pre-commit run --all
```

This fails to compile locally for me:

```
In file included from modules/gdscript/editor/.scu/scu_modules_gdscript_editor.gen.cpp:2:
./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.cpp:31:1: error: '' does not name a type
   31 | /**************************************************************************/
      |  
In file included from ./editor/script/syntax_highlighters.h:33,
                 from ./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.h:33,
                 from ./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.cpp:61:
./scene/resources/syntax_highlighter.h:48:9: error: 'TextEdit' does not name a type
   48 |         TextEdit *text_edit = nullptr;
      |         ^~~~~~~~
./scene/resources/syntax_highlighter.h:65:28: error: 'TextEdit' has not been declared
   65 |         void set_text_edit(TextEdit *p_text_edit);
      |                            ^~~~~~~~
./scene/resources/syntax_highlighter.h:66:9: error: 'TextEdit' does not name a type
   66 |         TextEdit *get_text_edit() const;
      |         ^~~~~~~~
./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.cpp: In member function 'virtual Dictionary GDScriptSyntaxHighlighter::_get_line_syntax_highlighting_impl(int)':
./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.cpp:109:15: warning: declaration of 'keyword_color' shadows a member of 'GDScriptSyntaxHighlighter' [-Wshadow]
  109 |         Color keyword_color;
      |               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~
./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.h:85:15: note: shadowed declaration is here
   85 |         Color keyword_color;
      |               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~
./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.cpp:128:29: error: 'text_edit' was not declared in this scope; did you mean 'TextEdit'?
  128 |         const String &str = text_edit->get_line_with_ime(p_line);
      |                             ^~~~~~~~~
      |                             TextEdit
./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.cpp: In member function 'virtual void GDScriptSyntaxHighlighter::_update_cache()':
./modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_highlighter.cpp:791:22: error: 'text_edit' was not declared in this scope; did you mean 'TextEdit'?
  791 |         font_color = text_edit->get_theme_color(SceneStringName(font_color));
      |                      ^~~~~~~~~
      |                      TextEdit
scons: *** [bin/obj/modules/gdscript/editor/.scu/scu_modules_gdscript_editor.gen.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.o] Error 1
```

The CI failure happens because you have a [BOM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Byte_order_mark) at the beginning of the file you modified. You need to remove it, as well as the duplicated license header in that file. Doing this makes it compile successfully on my end.
